# A EUR rate in CAD with no `source:` and no `type:` line.
#
# gnucash-plaintext sets no source of its own on a price, so the price keeps
# GnuCash's default: source `invalid`, and no type.
#
# What this fixture produces: that price, created.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_a_prices_source_and_type_are_kept_as_gnucash_wrote_them.py.
price
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "EUR"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	time: "2026-01-02 12:00:00 +0000"
	value: "1.51"
